new_entities.name: DirectDebitInstruction
new_entities.description: Represents a Direct Debit Instruction (DDI) — the authorisation given by a customer (payer) to an originator (e.g. utility company) permitting that originator to collect variable or fixed amounts from the customer's account via the BACS scheme. Created when the bank (as paying PSP) receives an AUDDIS 0N instruction or when the customer sets up a DDI via the digital channel. Owned by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003). The DDI is the central entity for the BACS Direct Debit lifecycle.

fields.name: ddi_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-009. Immutable after creation. Internal identifier for the DDI record.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id (ENT-004, owned by SVC-001/CAP-001). Must reference an Account with status = active. Validated at PH-047 via cross-capability event-driven account confirmation. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: originator_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 18 characters (BACS field limit). Name of the originator organisation as registered in the BACS scheme. Example: 'BRITISH GAS'. Stored as received from AUDDIS instruction.

fields.name: originator_sun
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit BACS Service User Number (SUN). Identifies the originator in the BACS scheme. Must be validated against the BACS SUN directory at PH-047. Format: numeric string, exactly 6 digits. Example: '123456'.

fields.name: reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 18 characters. Originator-assigned reference identifying the customer's account with the originator (e.g. customer number, contract reference). Used in BACS file submissions. Must be unique per originator_sun on active instructions for the same account_id.

fields.name: amount_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: fixed | variable. Fixed: same amount collected each time (e.g. fixed subscription). Variable: amount may differ per collection (e.g. utility bill, credit card minimum payment). For variable DDs, advance notice of collection amount is best practice under Consumer Duty.

fields.name: fixed_amount
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when amount_type = fixed. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places (GBP). Must be > 0.00. Null when amount_type = variable.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | active | cancelled | suspended. Transitions: pending (created at PH-046) → active (BACS confirmation received at PH-048); active → cancelled (AUDDIS 0C submitted — customer request or originator cancellation); active → suspended (bank-initiated suspension, e.g. account frozen). No transition from cancelled back to active — a new DDI must be established.

fields.name: setup_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The date on which the DirectDebitInstructionCreated event (EVT-069) was published. Immutable.

fields.name: first_collection_date
fields.validation_rule: Optional. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The expected date of the first BACS collection, as specified by the originator at DDI setup. May be null if not provided. Informational only — the originator controls actual submission timing.

fields.name: bacs_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required after status transitions to active (PH-048). The BACS scheme reference assigned on AUDDIS confirmation. Format: per BACS AUDDIS specification. Null while status = pending.

fields.name: setup_channel
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: digital | paper | auddis_originator. Records how the DDI was initiated: digital (customer via web/mobile channel), paper (paper mandate — originator-submitted via AUDDIS), auddis_originator (originator submitted directly via AUDDIS without paper mandate).

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable. Set when ENT-034 is first persisted by SVC-009.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

relationships.description: DirectDebitInstruction belongs to one Account (the paying account). FK: account_id → Account.account_id. Cross-capability reference: ENT-004 is owned by SVC-001 (CAP-001).
One DirectDebitInstruction may have multiple DirectDebitCollection records (one per collection cycle).

design_decisions.decision: ENT-034 is owned by SVC-009 (CAP-003), not SVC-001 (CAP-001), despite referencing Account (ENT-004) which is CAP-001-owned.
design_decisions.rationale: The DDI is a BACS scheme artefact whose lifecycle (AUDDIS submission, validation, collection, indemnity) is entirely within the Payment Operations capability. The account reference is a FK to an external entity — standard cross-capability reference pattern. Placing ENT-034 in CAP-001 would misrepresent capability ownership.

design_decisions.decision: fixed_amount is stored on the DDI only for amount_type = fixed. For variable DDs, the amount is on each DirectDebitCollection record (ENT-035).
design_decisions.rationale: Fixed amount is an attribute of the instruction (it defines what the originator will always collect). Variable amount is an attribute of each individual collection. This models the BACS scheme semantics correctly.

new_entities.name: DirectDebitCollection
new_entities.description: Represents a single BACS Direct Debit collection event — one execution of a payment against an active DirectDebitInstruction. Created by SVC-009 when the originator submits a collection instruction via BACS at D-2 (2 working days before the debit date). Updated when the collection is processed (debited or returned) on D-0. Owned by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003).

fields.name: collection_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-009. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: ddi_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → DirectDebitInstruction.ddi_id (ENT-034). Must reference a DirectDebitInstruction with status = active. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places (GBP). The amount to be collected as specified by the originator in the BACS collection file. For fixed-amount DDIs, must equal DirectDebitInstruction.fixed_amount. For variable DDIs, validated against any agreed maximum.

fields.name: collection_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The BACS debit date — the D-0 date on which the account will be debited. Must be a valid BACS working day. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: submission_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The date the collection file was received from BACS (D-2). Must be exactly 2 working days before collection_date per BACS scheme rules. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: submitted | collected | returned | indemnity_claimed. Transitions: submitted (at D-2, PH-049) → collected (D-0 debit successful, PH-050) or returned (D-0 debit failed, PH-050); collected or returned → indemnity_claimed (customer claims under DD Guarantee, PH-051).

fields.name: return_reason
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status = returned. BACS ARUDD return reason code. Common values: ARUDD-1 (Refer to Payer), ARUDD-2 (Principal/Interest/Charges — paid), ARUDD-5 (No Account), ARUDD-B (Account Closed), ARUDD-C (Account Transferred), ARUDD-D (Advance Notice Disputed), ARUDD-R (Instruction Cancelled). Null when status != returned.

fields.name: bacs_transaction_reference
fields.validation_rule: Optional. BACS-assigned transaction reference from the collection file. Used for scheme reconciliation and dispute resolution.

fields.name: indemnity_claimed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status = indemnity_claimed. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp at which EVT-074 (DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled) was published.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable. Set when ENT-035 is first persisted at D-2 collection submission.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

relationships.description: DirectDebitCollection belongs to one DirectDebitInstruction. FK: ddi_id → DirectDebitInstruction.ddi_id.

design_decisions.decision: DirectDebitCollection (ENT-035) is a separate entity from DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034) rather than a status on the instruction.
design_decisions.rationale: A single DDI may have many collections over its lifetime (monthly, quarterly, etc.). Each collection has independent lifecycle states (submitted, collected, returned, indemnity_claimed). Modelling collections as a separate entity with FK to the instruction is consistent with the BACS scheme semantics and supports accurate financial reconciliation and dispute history.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Customer
referenced_existing_entities.reference_purpose: Customer identity for DDI setup — account holder name matching during AUDDIS validation (PH-047). PER-001 is the triggering persona.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Account
referenced_existing_entities.reference_purpose: The paying account from which Direct Debit collections are debited. ENT-034 holds a FK to ENT-004 (account_id). SVC-001 performs balance checks and debits the account ledger at D-0 (PH-050).

entity_extensions.description: Account now has a one-to-many relationship with DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034). One Account may have multiple active DDIs from different originators.
entity_extensions.design_note: ENT-034 is owned by SVC-009 (CAP-003). The relationship is expressed as a FK on ENT-034 pointing to ENT-004 — ENT-004 itself does not store a list of DDI IDs. Cross-capability referential integrity is maintained via event-driven validation at PH-047.
